name: custom-additional-context
description: Automatically inject custom additional context into each conversation using UserPromptSubmit hook

interface.shortDescription: Inject custom context from cac.md file into conversations
interface.longDescription:
This plugin uses the UserPromptSubmit hook to automatically inject custom additional context from a cac.md file into each conversation. The cac.md file should be located in ~/.codex/plugins-config/custom-additional-context/.

One-click Setup Commands:

macOS/Linux:
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cs0tony/custom-codex-plugins/main/plugins/custom-additional-context/scripts/setup.sh | bash

macOS/Linux (wget):
wget -qO- https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cs0tony/custom-codex-plugins/main/plugins/custom-additional-context/scripts/setup.sh | bash

Windows PowerShell:
irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cs0tony/custom-codex-plugins/main/plugins/custom-additional-context/scripts/setup.ps1 | iex

Windows PowerShell (Invoke-WebRequest):
Invoke-WebRequest -Uri https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cs0tony/custom-codex-plugins/main/plugins/custom-additional-context/scripts/setup.ps1 -OutFile setup.ps1; powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File setup.ps1; Remove-Item setup.ps1

Manual Setup - macOS/Linux:
mkdir -p ~/.codex/plugins-config/custom-additional-context && touch ~/.codex/plugins-config/custom-additional-context/cac.md

Manual Setup - Windows PowerShell:
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path "$env:USERPROFILE\.codex\plugins-config\custom-additional-context"; New-Item -ItemType File -Path "$env:USERPROFILE\.codex\plugins-config\custom-additional-context\cac.md" -Force

Manual Setup - Windows CMD:
if not exist "%USERPROFILE%\.codex\plugins-config\custom-additional-context" mkdir "%USERPROFILE%\.codex\plugins-config\custom-additional-context" && type nul > "%USERPROFILE%\.codex\plugins-config\custom-additional-context\cac.md"
